d:
Nikola Jokić (21 points, 13 rebounds, 10 assists) recorded a triple-double to propel the Nuggets to a 104-91 victory tonight in New Orleans. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 25 points along with 5 rebounds and 3 steals in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 2-2 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 0-4 for the season.
